wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 03-007 wires the four-position responder chain D_ProcessEvents runs in Chocolate Doom 2.2.1 d_main.c (M_Responder → AM_Responder → F_Responder → G_Responder). The new src/vanilla/responderChain.ts exposes only the dispatch wiring; the individual responder bodies are plugged in by subsequent launch-host-input steps (menu, automap, finale, game). The chain stops at the first responder that returns true, matching vanilla's short-circuit semantics. The canonical order is pinned by VANILLA_RESPONDER_ORDER and VANILLA_RESPONDER_COUNT=4; routeEventThroughResponderChain validates the caller passes exactly four responders.
